title: President Trump Suggests ‘Injecting’ Disinfectant as Coronavirus Cure | NBC New York
summary: NBC New York clip of President Trump at an April 2020 press conference asking whether disinfectant could be injected as a coronavirus treatment, following a presentation on sunlight and decontamination.
why: Used mainly as a political reference in arguments over what Trump actually said and in criticism of him, not as something to learn from.
